sources.snippet: Overview Flux2-Klein-9B-Consistency is a fine-tuned variant of the FLUX.2-klein-9B text-to-image model built by dx8152. The model generates images from text prompts and operates as an image-to-image diffusion model compatible with the diffusers library.
